Thanks again for the quick connect earlier. Attached are our completed onboarding form and the draft SOW for the integration work (Helio will be billing monthly). Can you confirm the PO issuance process and typical lead time? Our procurement team would like a provisional PO so we can align our internal billing schedule — target spend for Q1 is $75,000, but we can break that into two line items if that helps Redwood's ledger.

Attachments: Helio_Onboard_Form.pdf (PDF), Helio_SOW_v1.docx (DOCX)

- Provisional PO number and expected date of issuance

Hi Alex — welcome. I got the form and SOW, thanks. Fast answers below and a couple of follow-ups so we can get a clean PO issued without back-and-forth: 

1) Missing fields: the onboarding form is missing the Redwood billing contact (we need both a billing email and a cost-center code). Could you add the internal Helio billing contact?

2) Spend cap: $75,000 is fine as an overall cap. Can you confirm how Helio prefers that represented on the PO — single consolidated line for "Platform services" with monthly invoicing, or split into two lines: "Platform services (monthly)" and "Professional services (integration)"? If you split, include the dollar split per line.

3) Lead time: Once we have completed form + cost center, our procurement team typically issues a provisional PO within 2 business days; Finance will convert that into an official PO once DocuSign is complete and final SOW is confirmed.

I'll loop in Ben from Accounting to draft the provisional PO once we have the billing contact and line-itemization.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Vendor Onboarding Lead, Procurement
Redwood Inference
aisha_rahman@redwood.com
[Attachment referenced: Helio_Onboard_Form.pdf]

Ben / Karthik — see Helio's onboarding packet attached. Helio confirmed $75k cap and are open to how we structure line items. Prefer to get a provisional PO to unblock their internal billing.

Suggested stand-up: provisional PO with two lines so ledger matches (Platform services monthly / Professional services integration). Karthik — can you confirm the correct GL/cost-center mapping for their "Platform services" monthly SKU? If we need to split the first month to cover a milestone payment, flag that now.

Alex — Ben will draft provisional PO and send DocuSign for their payment terms. If Helio sends a split amount, please reply to Ben's PO email with exact per-line amounts.

Thanks,
Aisha
